---
title: "Color options (R)"
format:
  html:
    code-tools: true
filters:
  - path: ../_filters/show-source.lua
    at: pre-ast
  - panzoom
panzoom:
  backdrop: "rgba(18, 52, 86, 0.92)"
  panel-background: "#f4e9d8"
  panel-color: "#3b2a1a"
  link-color: "#a0361b"
---

The YAML header sets the viewer's colors without CSS, giving a deep blue
backdrop, a cream caption band, dark brown caption text, and rust links. They
apply to every image on the page that opens in the viewer, except an
[image](#c2) or [code cell](#c4) that sets its own.

```yaml
---
panzoom:
  backdrop: "rgba(18, 52, 86, 0.92)"  # deep blue
  panel-background: "#f4e9d8"       # cream
  panel-color: "#3b2a1a"            # dark brown
  link-color: "#a0361b"               # rust
---
```

Each option sets one of the viewer's CSS variables. [Styling with
CSS](o-css-r.html) sets the same variables from a stylesheet, for some pages
only.

## Markdown image {#c1 expect-open="panzoom"}

A markdown image with `.panzoom`. It opens with the colors set under the
`panzoom:` option in the YAML header, a deep blue backdrop and a cream caption
band, and the link in its caption is rust.

```markdown {.show-source}
![Sunset at Chilmark Beach, Martha's Vineyard ([photo](https://unsplash.com/photos/VBDJGOMCwps)).](../images/mv-0.jpg){.panzoom fig-alt="Sunset over a sandy beach, with a tall rock stack against the sun"}
```

## Colors for one image {#c2 expect-open="panzoom"}

A markdown image with `.panzoom` and colors of its own, set as attributes. It
opens with a deep green backdrop and a pale green caption band instead of the
colors set under the `panzoom:` option in the YAML header, and the link in its
caption is dark green.

```markdown {.show-source}
![Waves breaking below the clay cliffs at Aquinnah, Martha's Vineyard ([photo](https://unsplash.com/photos/2iQnDPLIXwU)).](../images/mv-1.jpg){.panzoom backdrop="rgba(20, 60, 40, 0.92)" panel-background="#e8f3ea" panel-color="#173d24" link-color="#0b6b3a" fig-alt="Waves breaking below grassy clay cliffs at Aquinnah"}
```

## Code cell {#c3 expect-open="panzoom"}

An R cell with `#| panzoom: true`. It opens with the blue and cream colors set
under the `panzoom:` option in the YAML header.

```{r}
#| panzoom: true
#| fig-alt: "Scatter plot of vapor pressure rising steeply with temperature"
#| fig-cap: "Vapor pressure of mercury against temperature."

plot(pressure, type = "b", pch = 19)
```

## Colors for one cell {#c4 expect-open="panzoom"}

An R cell with colors of its own under the `panzoom` cell option. It opens with
a dark red backdrop and a peach caption band.

```{r}
#| panzoom:
#|   backdrop: "rgba(70, 25, 15, 0.92)"
#|   panel-background: "#fbe9dc"
#|   panel-color: "#4a1f10"
#| fig-alt: "Scatter plot of stopping distance against speed for 50 cars"
#| fig-cap: "Stopping distance against speed for 50 cars."

plot(cars, pch = 19)
```

## Gallery with mixed colors {#c5 expect-open="panzoom" expect-steps="true" expect-overlay="rgba(20, 60, 40, 0.92); rgba(18, 52, 86, 0.92); rgba(70, 25, 15, 0.92)" expect-band="rgb(232, 243, 234); rgb(244, 233, 216); rgb(251, 233, 220)"}

A gallery of three images. The first has a deep green backdrop and a pale green
caption band of its own, the second has no colors of its own and shows the blue
and cream set under the `panzoom:` option in the YAML header, and the third has
a dark red backdrop and a peach band of its own. Each image shows its colors
while it is open, and stepping to the next or previous one doesn't keep them.

```markdown {.show-source}
![Edgartown Lighthouse, Martha's Vineyard.](../images/mv-2.jpg){.panzoom group="mixed" backdrop="rgba(20, 60, 40, 0.92)" panel-background="#e8f3ea" panel-color="#173d24" fig-alt="A white lighthouse against a blue sky"}

![A gingerbread cottage in Oak Bluffs, Martha's Vineyard.](../images/mv-3.jpg){.panzoom group="mixed" fig-alt="A shingled gingerbread cottage with pink and green trim, behind a garden path"}

![A sailboat off Edgartown, Martha's Vineyard.](../images/mv-4.jpg){.panzoom group="mixed" backdrop="rgba(70, 25, 15, 0.92)" panel-background="#fbe9dc" panel-color="#4a1f10" fig-alt="A sailboat with a flag-striped sail off a sandy beach"}
```
